meta.basis: El Hiloush, Principles of Maps, via 'Cartography Knowledge Graph and AI Agent Skills' (user-supplied PDF, 2026-10-23). Design rules marked synthesis in that guide are applied as standard GIS practice.
meta.one_line_classification: Small-scale interactive thematic history map of Sudan and its neighbours, qualitative categories (polity control, groups, settlement roles), time-scrubbed across 68 eras, web screen 390 px to desktop.

six_declarations.datum: WGS 84; all layers stored in EPSG:4326 (Wikidata P625, Pleiades, OpenHistoricalMap, Natural Earth are WGS 84). No datum transformation applied; none needed.

projection_display.default: EPSG:3857 Web Mercator (conformal; preserves local shape and direction). At Sudan's latitudes (~3-23°N) area inflation is ~0.1-17%, uneven north-south.
projection_display.area_comparison: Equal-area option: Lambert Azimuthal Equal-Area centred 30°E 15°N (proj string '+proj=laea +lat_0=15 +lon_0=30 +datum=WGS84 +units=m'). Use for any 'which polity was bigger' view and for all area numbers. Mercator must never be used for area comparison.
projection_display.disclosure_en: Web Mercator display: shapes are true locally, areas are not comparable.
projection_display.disclosure_ar: عرض ميركاتور للويب: الأشكال صحيحة محلياً لكن المساحات غير قابلة للمقارنة.

six_declarations.scale: Small scale (smaller than 1:500,000 at all usable zooms). Positions are anchor points and generalised extents: never use for measurement claims. Distances/areas, if shown, computed in the LAEA CRS in metres, never in degrees.
six_declarations.vintage: Per layer: each era's extent/city/group record carries its source_ids and the dataset build date (2026-10-24). Modern population: UN WUP 2025 revision (MODEL).
six_declarations.classification: Qualitative only: distinct hues/shapes for categories; no ordered ramps. Population (if shown) as proportional symbols of totals, never choropleth of raw counts.
six_declarations.height_reference: Terrain basemap heights are orthometric (above mean sea level) as published by the basemap provider; no ellipsoidal heights shown.

palette_note: Polity fills use a qualitative, colour-vision-safe set (Okabe-Ito hues) assigned per polity id; checked to survive greyscale by pairing every hue with a distinct dash/shape.

symbol_classes.time_window: Drawn while visible_from <= era <= visible_to. While the place holds a cited role in the era it uses its role shape; after its last role but before visible_to it uses this ruin symbol.
symbol_classes.open_end: visible_to null and badge RUIN-UNDATED: draw from visible_from in every later era, with the dashed outline plus a small '?' tick at upper right, and the popup line 'End date not established in sources read' (AR flagged for review).
symbol_classes.end_basis_display: Popup states visible_to_basis: last_attested (show its LAST-ATTESTED[+APPROXIMATE] badge and cite), last_cited_role, or abandoned.
symbol_classes.label: italic, grey #8a8f94, lowest label priority

symbol_classes.note: appears only in the legend list panel
hillshade never alone: pair with tint key in metres above sea level; source must be PD/CC0/CC BY (e.g. Natural Earth raster, PD)

symbol_classes.data: image/credit from db/era_symbols.json; position = db/era_focus.json flag_anchor
symbol_classes.time_window: shown when the scrub year is inside the era AND inside ANY of that flag's used_windows (list of [start,end]; e.g. Libya 1949-1969 and 2011-2026); popup states the windows
symbol_classes.multiple: joint_flags (e.g. Condominium UK + Egypt) drawn side by side, centred on the anchor, 2px gap
symbol_classes.text_only: emblem.text_only entries (e.g. Mahdist banner colours) appear only in the popup; no marker
symbol_classes.null: flag null / display_hint 'no known flag' = no marker; popup may show the null reason
symbol_classes.war_era: war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf shows only the state flag of Sudan, with popup note: 'state flag only; implies no territorial control'. Armed-group flags are never shown.
symbol_classes.popup: author, licence, Commons file page link, usage_source cite; MODERN_SVG_RENDERING badge

symbol_classes.note: Contested stays points-only per uncertainty_encoding.CONTESTED; never a polygon.

symbol_classes.applies_when: confidence_style == 'hatched' (not on contested); numeric confidence alone adds no hatch

symbol_classes.label_en: Where the 1932 Seligman map places the name (1910s–30s); not a boundary or claim
symbol_classes.label_ar: موضع الاسم على خريطة سليغمان لعام 1932 (من العقد الثاني حتى الثلاثينيات من القرن العشرين)، وليس حدًا أو مطالبة [يحتاج تحقق]

swatch.note: also draw the region polygon if present: fill #f08c6c @0.10, stroke #f08c6c 1 dash 4 3

swatch.combine: reported + region gives this icon plus the halo at 0.5 opacity

APPROXIMATE.rule: dashed outline [4,3], halve fill opacity, feathered edge

CONTESTED.rule: amber hatch + dashed line; points only for the 5 disputed areas; tooltip lists both claims

SINGLE-SOURCE.rule: small '1' superscript glyph on label; popup states single source

VERIFY.rule: hollow symbol + '?' glyph; excluded from social exports

FIRST-ATTESTED.rule: symbol appears with a left-open fade-in tick on the time slider: place is older than its first mention

RUIN-UNDATED.rule: symbol fades out over the last role's end; no hard end tick

MODEL.rule: value in grey italics with 'model' tag; proportional circle with dashed rim

REPORTED.rule: open triangle; popup names reporting body

gis_furniture.scale_bar: metric (km) + imperial toggle; recomputed for latitude of map centre (Mercator scale varies by latitude); hide numeric RF on web
gis_furniture.graticule: 5° lines, labelled at frame edge, 0.5px #999 at 50%; toggle; densify lines so they curve correctly in LAEA
gis_furniture.north_arrow: shown only in LAEA mode (north not uniformly up away from centre); omitted in Web Mercator where north is up

gis_furniture.info_panel: metadata panel stating the six declarations (interactive equivalent of marginalia)

homelands_layer.reason: Homeland records carry no dates in the sources read, so they are not tied to any era; one background toggle in every era.

style.soft_area: fill #009E73 at 0.12, no stroke, radial fade, only where a source gives an area
style.point: circle 8 px, fill #009E73 at 0.6, white 0.8 px halo
style.label: group name, small caps, #5fd3ad, below city labels

homelands_layer.label_colour_note: Labels render at #5fd3ad instead of Okabe-Ito #009E73 for readability on the dark basemap (Innovation Manager ruling, 2026-10-24)
homelands_layer.badge_display: Badge chips (e.g. SINGLE-SOURCE, APPROXIMATE, CONTESTED, AR-REVIEW) in popup; APPROXIMATE points get a dashed halo; CONTESTED gets the amber outline from uncertainty_encoding.
homelands_layer.popup: name EN/AR, source_ids with page cites, note 'Not dated: shown for orientation, not as era control'.

shared_model.reference: legend per-toggle definition (homelands_layer): one era-independent background toggle, off by default, same homelands.geojson in every era

economy_rating.rule: Shown only in eras with an entry in db/era_economy.json. Rating never by colour alone: each has a distinct shape + glyph; Okabe-Ito hues, checked in greyscale and deuteranopia/protanopia (good vs bad differ by shape and direction, not only hue).

editorial_marker.style: dotted ring around the symbol, stroke #000000, width 1.5px, dash [1,2], gap 2px
editorial_marker.label_en: Editorial judgement (no source states the rating directly)
editorial_marker.label_ar: تقدير تحريري (لا يذكر مصدر التقييم مباشرة)

economy_rating.chip: Web Lead renders as Economy chip on era card; the glyph + label are shown with the colour.

style.arrow: arrowhead at to_id end; both ends if direction == "both"

trade_route.commodity_note: Colour is secondary: commodity name is in the tooltip and legend row label.
trade_route.schematic_rule: Great-circle between cited endpoints; schematic=true; APPROXIMATE (dashes widen to [3,4] per uncertainty_encoding) unless the source gives a path.

borders_legend.purpose: Every badge used on db/extents features and border points is listed in the Borders legend, so no shape reads as more certain than its source. Badge names match db/era_badge_counts.json meta.badges exactly.

This bar is valid only once the dem_ramp tint is drawn; until then the legend must show the hillshade row (map.js lsw.hs, 'Hillshade from elevation model (Esri World Hillshade)') and NOT this bar.

heatmap.counts: battles in /b.json that have coordinates (b.ll non-null), each weighted equally (one kernel, radius 18px*sqrt(zoom)); ev/ events are NOT included (no coordinates). Not filtered by era. Normalised to the densest spot in the current view, so 1 = local maximum, not an absolute count.
heatmap.title_en: Density of mapped battle locations (relative, no units)
heatmap.title_ar: كثافة مواقع المعارك المرسومة (نسبية، بلا وحدات) [يحتاج تحقق]
heatmap.note_en: Battles with known coordinates only; scale re-normalised to the current view. Reported 2023+ clashes are not a measure of control or intensity.
heatmap.note_ar: المعارك ذات الإحداثيات المعروفة فقط؛ يُعاد ضبط المقياس حسب العرض الحالي. الاشتباكات المُبلغ عنها منذ 2023 ليست مقياسًا للسيطرة أو الشدة [يحتاج تحقق]
heatmap.drawn_status: matches site working tree heatDraw() (HRAMP = heatmap_ramp, opacity .75)

legend_ids.problem: web/mapsite.py (Web Lead build of lg/) uses symbol_class as row id (id=cls), so lg/<era>.json rows {l:'hml',id:'list_only_text'} and {l:'grp',id:'list_only_text'} collide in 18 eras.
legend_ids.row_id: <layer>:<symbol_class> from era legend legend_rows[] (e.g. homelands:list_only_text, groups:list_only_text, extents:list_only_text)
legend_ids.feature_id: <prefix>:<era>:<feature_id> drawn, <prefix>-list:<era>:<feature_id> list-only (prefixes extent, group, city, battle, draft, route, ethno); homelands are era-independent: homelands:<feature_id> / homelands-list:<feature_id>
legend_ids.web_lead_action: in web/mapsite.py set lg row id from legend_rows[].row_id (or f'{layer}:{cls}') instead of cls; IM does not edit web/ or lg/.
legend_ids.uniqueness: build_legends.py asserts all row_id/legend_id unique within each era legend; toggle ids are disjoint by prefix.
